title: RepoChangeBundle (v1)
description: The evidence bundle of one governed repo change. Its bytes MUST be exactly its canonical JSON (RFC 8785).

schema.description: Type tag read by verifySubjectBinding; equals the grant's subject_binding.artifact_schema.

repo.description: The repository the change lands in; compared byte-exact with the verifier's expected repository.

base_ref.description: The protected branch the change lands on.

object_format.description: Git object format of the repository; fixes the length of every object id.

items.description: A path the change may add or modify, compared byte-exact with git's path bytes.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the change may add or modify. Unique.

max_changed_files.description: The most entries one change may have.

task.description: The task text the run starts from; the receipt's prompt_hash is hex SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

scope.description: The principal's detached scope for one repository task, bound into a StandingDelegation by subject_binding.

grant_id.description: UUID — the grant's stable handle; names the bundle and any revocation file.

delegator_id.description: Delegator's motebit identity — the entity granting standing authority.

delegator_public_key.description: Delegator's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase). Verifies `signature`. Embedded so verification needs no relay lookup.

delegate_id.description: Delegate's motebit identity — the entity authorized to mint per-tick tokens.

delegate_public_key.description: Delegate's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase). Per-tick tokens must name this same delegate.

scope.description: Comma-separated capability CEILING, or `*`. Each minted per-tick token's scope must narrow within this. Same grammar as DelegationToken.scope (market-v1 §12.3).

subject.description: Human-meaningful binding (e.g. `research:thesis=acme-q3`). Opaque to verification; carried for receipt-linkage and operator legibility.

subject_binding.description: Optional (standing-delegation@1.1). Digest-binds the resolved subject-scope artifact this grant's authority reaches; part of the signed body, so the delegator's signature covers the resolved scope. Absent ⇒ a @1.0 grant with no signed resolved scope (higher-assurance consumers MUST fail closed). NOT the capability `scope`.

schema.description: This binding's own type tag (in-body domain separation).

artifact_schema.description: Declared type of the detached artifact this digest addresses (e.g. `motebit.monitor-scope.v1`). The verifier MUST check the presented artifact's `schema` equals this, fail-closed.

digest_method.description: How `digest` was computed: `hex(SHA-256(canonicalJson(artifact)))`. A new hash is a new literal here, never a silent change. NOT a signature `suite`.

digest.description: `hex(SHA-256(canonicalJson(detached artifact)))`, 64 lowercase. Recompute from the artifact as received so JSON whitespace can't break the match.

spend_ceiling.description: Optional (standing-delegation@1.2). The delegator's signed autonomous-spend ceiling — the HOW-MUCH this grant authorizes, as a cryptographic commitment (part of the signed body). Absent ⇒ the grant authorizes NO autonomous money (enforcers deny `ceiling_absent`, fail-closed) — a @1.0/@1.1 grant verifies unchanged and simply cannot move money.

schema.description: This ceiling's own type tag (in-body domain separation).

cumulative_limit_micro.description: Max cumulative spend (integer micro-USD, ≤ 2^53−1 for JCS number fidelity) within one rolling window. Requires `window_ms`. A SET value of 0 denies all positive spend on this dimension.

per_counterparty_limit_micro.description: Max spend (integer micro-USD, ≤ 2^53−1) to any single canonical counterparty within one window. Requires `window_ms`. Counterparty canonicalization is consumer-local runtime law (spec §3.3).

max_action_count.description: Max number of money actions within one window (≤ 2^53−1). Requires `window_ms`.

lifetime_limit_micro.description: Max cumulative spend (integer micro-USD, ≤ 2^53−1) over the grant's ENTIRE life — never reset by a window roll. The offline-meaningful total bound (paired with the grant's `expires_at`).

window_ms.description: Rolling window length in ms (≤ 2^53−1). Required (> 0) when any per-window limit is set.

cadence_ms.description: Authorized minimum firing interval, milliseconds. A per-tick rate limit enforced at mint/relay time — NOT a single-token verification rule.

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the grant was issued.

not_before.description: Optional activation delay (Unix ms). Null ⇒ active from `issued_at`.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds after which the grant is invalid. Long-but-finite and renewable — NOT open-ended; the delegate renews by re-signing. See standing-delegation-v1 §6 D1.

max_token_ttl_ms.description: Ceiling on each minted token's `(expires_at - issued_at)`. Keeps per-tick tokens short-lived even though the grant lives long.

suite.description: Cryptosuite identifier. Always `motebit-jcs-ed25519-b64-v1`: JCS (RFC 8785), Ed25519, base64url signature, hex public keys.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, canonical unpadded base64url: 86 characters ending in A, Q, g or w.

grant.description: The principal's StandingDelegation to the agent.

delegator_id.description: Delegator's motebit identity — UUIDv7 string. The entity authorizing the delegation.

delegator_public_key.description: Delegator's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase characters). Used to verify `signature`. Embedded so verification does not require a relay lookup.

delegate_id.description: Delegate's motebit identity — UUIDv7 string. The entity receiving the authorization.

delegate_public_key.description: Delegate's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase characters). Binds the delegation to a specific cryptographic identity — a different keypair cannot exercise the token.

scope.description: Comma-separated capability list the delegate may invoke, or `*` for wildcard. Exhaustive match required at invocation time — absent capabilities are denied. See market-v1 §12.3.

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the token was issued.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds after which the token is invalid. Verifiers reject tokens where `now > expires_at`.

not_before.description: Optional activation time (Unix ms). Present ⇒ the token is INVALID before it — verifiers reject when `now < not_before`. Makes pre-minting honest: a standing grant's delegator can sign a future slot's tick at grant-creation, and it cannot verify until its slot. Absent ⇒ active from `issued_at` (today's behavior). standing-delegation@1.0 §3.

grant_id.description: REQUIRED here: the grant this tick belongs to.

suite.description: Cryptosuite identifier. Always `motebit-jcs-ed25519-b64-v1` for delegation tokens today: JCS canonicalization (RFC 8785), Ed25519 signature, base64url-encoded signature, hex-encoded public keys. See @motebit/protocol SUITE_REGISTRY.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, canonical unpadded base64url: 86 characters ending in A, Q, g or w.

tick.description: The principal's per-tick DelegationToken under the grant.

task_id.description: The run's task_id; equals the ExecutionReceipt's.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, 64 lowercase hex characters.

invocation_origin.description: How the act was authorized for invocation. Signature-bound.

suite.description: Cryptosuite: JCS, Ed25519, base64url signature, hex public key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, canonical unpadded base64url: 86 characters ending in A, Q, g or w.

items.description: A signed record of one tool call, in the repo-change profile.

tool_receipts.description: Every tool receipt of the run.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, 64 lowercase hex characters.

result.description: The change record (RepoChangeResult) as canonical JSON, for every status.

tools_used.description: Names of the tools the run used.

prompt_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the scope's task.

result_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of result.

delegated_scope.description: The tick's scope. A verifier requires it, within the tick's scope.

invocation_origin.description: How the act was authorized for invocation. Signature-bound.

suite.description: Cryptosuite: JCS, Ed25519, base64url signature, hex public key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, canonical unpadded base64url: 86 characters ending in A, Q, g or w.

receipt.description: The agent's signed outcome, in the repo-change profile.
